description: This Harvard Dataverse deposit contains a household survey of 1,028 Ecuadorian rice growers in Guayas, Los Ríos, Manabí and El Oro. CIAT and INIAP surveyed farming households between October 2014 and March 2015 to study improved-variety adoption and production practices. The public release lists a Stata data file, variable dictionary, questionnaire, descriptive report and Stata command file. Fields cover household characteristics, plot management, input use, costs, yield, rice use and prices. The Dataverse API names the dataset and states CC BY 4.0 terms with free, unrestricted files. Its HTML landing page responded HTTP 202 from this environment, so the API is the verified metadata route. The four-province sample and respondent accounts do not constitute a live national crop census. A metadata field says 2014 only, while the article states the survey extended into March 2015; both statements are retained. Modellers could parameterise adoption behaviour in farm decision simulations. data-farm-size-crop-specific-harvested-areas-56-countries is related but differently aggregated. No survey file was downloaded.
